mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a probability distribution that has a probability density function."
A continuous probability distribution is a probability distribution that has a probability density function.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical function used in probability theory and statistics that estimates the likelihood that various possible outcomes of an experiment will occur."
A probability distribution is a mathematical function used in probability theory and statistics that estimates the likelihood that various possible outcomes of an experiment will occur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means under the null hypothesis constitutes the null value, to sum up."
The difference in sample means under the null hypothesis constitutes the null value, to sum up.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those parameters that are used in estimating variables of selected population parameters."
Sample parameters are those parameters that are used in estimating variables of selected population parameters.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when two separates sets of independent and identically distributed samples are obtained, one from each of the two populations being compared."
The independent samples t-test is used when two separates sets of independent and identically distributed samples are obtained, one from each of the two populations being compared.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a distribution function for discrete processes that has set probability for each independently generated value, similar to the binomial distribution."
The multinomial distribution is a distribution function for discrete processes that has set probability for each independently generated value, similar to the binomial distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the square roots of these expressions."
The standard deviations are the square roots of these expressions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a suitable model for the random behavior of percentages and proportions."
The beta distribution is a suitable model for the random behavior of percentages and proportions.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for a variety of purposes, including the measurement of various possible outcomes, a random experiment, survey, and procedure of statistical inferences."
Probability distributions are used for a variety of purposes, including the measurement of various possible outcomes, a random experiment, survey, and procedure of statistical inferences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the pattern of the variable's frequency, whereas the frequency is how frequently a value occurs within an interval."
The distribution is the pattern of the variable's frequency, whereas the frequency is how frequently a value occurs within an interval.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to represent the probability distribution curve for a continuous random variable."
The function f(x) is used to represent the probability distribution curve for a continuous random variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine all reasonably likely values of the difference between two population means."
Confidence interval is used to determine all reasonably likely values of the difference between two population means.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a sampling method where the sample is chosen based on criteria other than pure chance."
Non-random sampling refers to a sampling method where the sample is chosen based on criteria other than pure chance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a representation that shows the number of observations inside a specific interval, either in a graphical or tabular manner."
A frequency distribution is a representation that shows the number of observations inside a specific interval, either in a graphical or tabular manner.
fib: ______ is a quantity resulting from a random experiment that by chance can assume different values.
random variable
A random variable is a quantity resulting from a random experiment that by chance can assume different values.
______ is the fundamental presumption used in the majority of parametric tests.
distribution of populations
The distribution of populations is the fundamental presumption used in the majority of parametric tests.
______ is considered to be known when we know the probability distribution 𝑓(𝑥) (probability function or density function) of the associated random variable 𝑥.
population
A population is considered to be known when we know the probability distribution 𝑓(𝑥) (probability function or density function) of the associated random variable 𝑥.
______ is the ratio of the mean squared error between these two groups, and ANOVA separates the within-group variance from the between-group variance.
F-test
The F-test is the ratio of the mean squared error between these two groups, and ANOVA separates the within-group variance from the between-group variance.
______ is any statistical test in which the test statistic follows a student's t distribution if the null hypothesis is supported.
t-test
A t-test is any statistical test in which the test statistic follows a student's t distribution if the null hypothesis is supported.
______ are the two types of probability distributions.
Continuous or discrete probability distributions
Continuous or discrete probability distributions are the two types of probability distributions.
______ is a two-parameter family of continuous probability distributions.
gamma distribution
The gamma distribution is a two-parameter family of continuous probability distributions.
______ is used to compare two different set of values.
T test
T test is used to compare two different set of values.
______ is a collection of probability distributions on a set of all possible outcomes of an experiment while a variable is any characteristic, number, or quantity that can be measured or counted.
statistical model

A statistical model is a collection of probability distributions on a set of all possible outcomes of an experiment while a variable is any characteristic, number, or quantity that can be measured or counted.
______ is one of the most popular models used in statistical tests of hypothesis.
normal curve
The normal curve is one of the most popular models used in statistical tests of hypothesis.
______ is a random variable where the data can take infinitely many values.
continuous random variable
A continuous random variable is a random variable where the data can take infinitely many values.
______ is a generalization of the geometric distribution, just as the gamma distribution is a generalization of the exponential distribution.
negative binomial distribution
The negative binomial distribution is a generalization of the geometric distribution, just as the gamma distribution is a generalization of the exponential distribution.

______ is used to examine whether the distributions of categorical variable in question differ from another and its yield data in categories, whereas, the numerical variables yield data in numerical form.
Chi- square

Chi- square is used to examine whether the distributions of categorical variable in question differ from another and its yield data in categories, whereas, the numerical variables yield data in numerical form.
______ is the use of mathematical models and statistical assumptions to generate sample data and make predictions about the real world.
Statistical modeling
Statistical modeling is the use of mathematical models and statistical assumptions to generate sample data and make predictions about the real world.
